entities.name: Elmegraun
entities.description: Member of the Weatherlight's engine room crew who was killed by green powerbolts, melting into a puddle.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Ship Elmegraun served on, which suffered a catastrophic malfunction before its Compleation.

entities.name: Shanna
entities.description: Leader of the group Elmegraun's party sought out.

entities.name: Velena
entities.description: Crew member who tried to warn Shanna's group and was also killed.

entities.name: Arvad
entities.description: Crew member who accompanied Velena and Elmegraun.

events.summary: After the Weatherlight malfunctioned, Elmegraun accompanied Velena and Arvad to find Shanna and the others.
events.quote: Elmegraun accompanied Velena and Arvad when they sought out Shanna and the others

events.summary: A barrage of sickly green powerbolts hit the group; Elmegraun and Velena melted into puddles and died instantly.
events.quote: Elmegraun, like Velena, was caught in the attack and melted into a puddle, perishing instantly.

relations.quote: Elmegraun was a member of the Weatherlight 's engine room crew.
